title: Storage: Volumes, PVs & StatefulSets
summary: Give pods data that outlives containers: ephemeral volumes, PersistentVolumes and Claims, StorageClasses and dynamic provisioning, StatefulSets running PostgreSQL, CSI drivers like EBS, snapshots and backups, and why databases on Kubernetes need operators and care.
objectives: Choose between emptyDir, hostPath, configMap/secret/projected and persistent volumes
Explain the PV/PVC/StorageClass model and how dynamic provisioning and binding work
Use access modes, reclaim policies and `volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer` correctly
Run PostgreSQL in a StatefulSet with volumeClaimTemplates and a headless Service
Debug Pending PVCs and silent data loss caused by wrong mount paths
Describe CSI drivers, the EBS CSI driver on EKS, VolumeSnapshots and backup strategies
Argue when to run a database on Kubernetes (with an operator like CloudNativePG) and when to use a managed service
